_comment: T086 golden fixture expected values. This file states the SUBSET of the future escape_classify.py --out document's fields this RED test asserts on -- not a full-document exact match (the tool's exact JSON envelope, key-ordering, and provenance fields such as classified_by/reviewed_by are T094's to design; C-002 of contracts/common-conventions.md only fixes canonical-JSON formatting, not this tool's schema name). The test's own checker (test_escape_classify_red.sh) searches the real --out document for an object whose item_id == 'ATM-953' wherever it nests, then compares the fields below -- so it is robust to the top-level container key name T094 eventually chooses (rows / classifications / items / etc.), while still being a REAL, non-vacuous check per field (constitution 11.4.107(10)/11.4.201).
